rv.q: Label•less aims for transcendent universality but achieves generic banality.

Mexican American Kiwi Villalobos, after arriving in the U.S. on a full scholarship, faces discrimination from fellow students when they learn he works as a night cleaner for food and rent, then proclaims, “My net worth is not my worth.” But when they sing, the cast blows the roof off.

cn.t: This Gen Z pop-music dance concert boasts an exuberant cast and soaring vocals, but critics find its message falls flat. The show hits its stride when focusing on high-energy choreography rather than dramatic substance.
